The findings are indicative of protothecosis affecting the central nervous system.

random.description: This is a microscopic histological image of a blood vessel within a tissue sample, likely stained with periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) or a similar fungal stain. The vascular lumen is heavily distended and densely packed with numerous round, yeast-like fungal spores. Inside the vessel, a fragmented fungal hyphal or vascular structure is also visible amidst the fungal elements. The overall appearance is characteristic of angioinvasive fungal infection, such as mucormycosis or aspergillosis, within a thrombosed vessel.
